correctness.rationale: An arbitrary length decomposes uniquely as \(tL+r\). All zero counts realized in each two-run period form the exact interval \([te+\max(0,r-f),te+\min(e,r)]\) by extremal phases and adjacent-phase continuity. With \(a>c\), endpoint order makes the common class count \(\max(0,1+\min(c,r)-\max(0,r-b)-t(a-c))\). Its level sets yield precisely \(t(a+d)\le n\le(t+1)(b+c)\) for \(0\le t\le\lfloor\min(b,c)/(a-c)\rfloor\), and direct counting gives the gap and maximal formulas. Python 3 verifier independently enumerated actual periodic factors for 2870 parameter pairs and 123682 length-and-class checks; finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Longest common Abelian factors are a motivated string-matching quantity. The formula gives the entire infinite pairwise class-count function and all support lengths, including exact growing forbidden gaps and sharp last length across all unequal positive two-run profiles of equal period. The surprising longer-match-with-shorter-nonmatch phenomenon is structural, not a textbook single input or arbitrary finite enumeration.
